name: Cave Girl
note:
Child of the Caves (girl). Prankster: never knocks anyone out; steals shiny things to a hidden hoard. Lasa talks her down at once.
<Nonlethal>
<Runs When Beaten>
<Talk Type: sapient>
<Talk Tags: cave, fae>
<Talk Mood: Wary>
<Talk Instant: 4>
<Talk Line Wary: She giggles behind her silver-stitched hat.>
<Talk Line Calm: "You're no fun.">
<Talk Line Pacified: "Fine, fine! We were only playing!">
<Talk Outcome: heal 30>
<Talk Soothe+: She giggles and stops waving her hands. | "You're funny.">
<Talk Soothe-: "Boring!">
<Talk Offer+: "Is it shiny? It's not shiny. ...I'll keep it anyway.">
<Talk Offer-: "Ew.">
<Talk Ask+: She taps her nose. "Secrets cost shiny things.">
<Talk Ask-: "Ask me nicely. Or with something shiny.">
<Talk Rite+: She goes quiet. "That's an old song.">
<Talk Threaten-: She sticks out her tongue and glows brighter!>
<Talk Plead+: "Oh, don't cry! We're only playing!">
<Talk Question>
Got anything shiny?
- Yes! Want to see? | +20 | Ooh! Gimme! | steal 10
- No, nothing. | -5 | Liar. Probably.
- Want to play a different game? | +15 | ...What game?
- [4] Sister, leave them be. | +40 | \N[4]? \N[4]! Fine, fine.
</Talk Question>
<Talk Question>
Why are you all so big?
- We're grown-up. Ish. | +5 | Huh.
- Why are you so small? | +10 | Rude! ...Fair.
</Talk Question>
<Talk Tell: She keeps glancing at anything that glints.>
<Talk Tell 5: She hums an old tunnel song under her breath. \N[4] would know it.>
<Talk Likes: 50>

name: Cave Boy
note:
Child of the Caves (boy). Prankster: never knocks anyone out; pulls off clothes; steals shiny things to a hidden hoard. Lasa talks him down at once.
<Nonlethal>
<Runs When Beaten>
<Talk Type: sapient>
<Talk Tags: cave, fae>
<Talk Mood: Wary>
<Talk Instant: 4>
<Talk Line Wary: He tips his red hat with a grin.>
<Talk Line Calm: "Aw. Spoilsport.">
<Talk Line Pacified: "We'll give it back. Probably. Someday.">
<Talk Outcome: item 3>
<Talk Soothe+: He pushes his hat back, grinning. "Alright, alright.">
<Talk Soothe-: "Nyah!">
<Talk Offer+: "For me? ...Is this a trick?">
<Talk Ask-: "Can't tell. It's a secret tunnel. Oops.">
<Talk Threaten-: He blows a raspberry.>
<Talk Plead+: "Hey, hey, no crying. Here." He sniffs too.>
<Talk Question>
Bet you can't catch me. Wanna bet?
- You're on! | +10 | Hah! Too slow already!
- No thanks. | -5 | Boooring.
- [5] (\N[5] glares at him.) | +25 | ...Sorry, mister.
</Talk Question>
<Talk Question>
What's the shiniest thing you ever saw?
- The sun on the sea. | +15 | Ooooh.
- A bronze helmet. | +5 | We'll find one.
- Your hat. | +20 | It IS a good hat.
</Talk Question>
<Talk Tell: He's eyeing your belt pouch. Hold on to your cowries.>
<Talk Likes: 50>

name: Forest Imp
note:
Forest child-fae. Prankster: never knocks anyone out. Threaten makes it dissolve into a puddle and flee (no reward); pleading works (it feels bad when kids cry). Falmi talks it down at once.
<Nonlethal>
<Runs When Beaten>
<Talk Type: spirit>
<Talk Tags: fae, forest>
<Talk Mood: Wary>
<Talk Plead: 40>
<Talk Flees: threaten>
<Talk Instant: 10>
<Talk Line Flee: *splash* It dissolves into a puddle.>
<Talk Line Calm: It sniffles. "We were just teasing...">
<Talk Line Pacified: "Come on, the path out is this way.">
<Talk Outcome: buff agi 3>
<Talk Soothe+: It peeks out from behind a fern.>
<Talk Soothe-: It blows a raspberry and hides.>
<Talk Offer+: It sniffs the gift and giggles.>
<Talk Ask+: It points one way, then the other. Then the first way again.>
<Talk Rite+: The leaves around it stir. It goes quiet.>
<Talk Plead+: Its lip wobbles. "Don't cry... we were just teasing!">
<Talk Question>
Are you lost? Lost lost lost?
- ...Yes. | +25 | Ha! Knew it. ...Come on, then.
- No! | -10 | Lost AND lying!
- [10] I'm the Lady's own. | +40 | Oh! Oh no. Sorry, sorry!
</Talk Question>
<Talk Tell: Its lip trembles when anyone looks sad.>
<Talk Tell 5: It's more scared than you are. One shout and it's a puddle.>
<Talk Likes: 50>

name: Green Horse
note:
The child-fae's near-invisible mount of leaves and boughs. Very hard to hit until soaked or weighed down. Burns easily. Doesn't respond to talk.
<Lose Evasion When: 74, 75, 76, 77>
<Talk Tell: Those leaves would droop if they were soaked or weighed down.>

name: Boar-Man
note:
People of the Forest. Enforce the forest agreements. Plain speaking works; bribes and cleverness backfire; a threat is honest, so it doesn't offend.
<Talk Type: sapient>
<Talk Tags: forest, boar>
<Talk Soothe: 15>
<Talk Plead: 20>
<Talk Offer: -15>
<Talk Threaten: 5>
<Talk Info: Cut only the marked trees. Burn only in the clearings. The owls are watching.>
<Talk Line Hostile: "You break the agreement!">
<Talk Line Calm: "Hrm. You speak plain. Good.">
<Talk Line Pacified: "Go. Keep to the marked paths.">
<Talk Outcome: info, buff def 3>
<Talk Soothe+: He grunts. "Speak plain, then." | His spear tip dips toward the ground.>
<Talk Soothe-: "Words. Always words.">
<Talk Offer-: "You think we can be BOUGHT?" | He knocks the offering out of your hand.>
<Talk Ask-: "Ask when you've earned it.">
<Talk Rite+: He bows his great head to the old words.>
<Talk Threaten+: He snorts a laugh. "Honest, at least.">
<Talk Plead+: "Hrm. You beg like you mean it.">
<Talk Question>
Why do you walk our forest?
- We need something from it. We'll take only that. | +20 | Hrm. Honest.
- Just passing through. | +5 | Hm.
- [5] I hunt here, by the agreement. | +25 | \N[5]. You keep the agreement.
- The forest belongs to everyone. | -15 | It belongs to the LADY!
</Talk Question>
<Talk Question>
Did you cut an unmarked tree?
- No. | +10 | ...Good.
- Yes. I'm sorry. | +20 | You tell the truth. That counts.
- What tree? | -15 | Clever. We hate clever.
</Talk Question>
<Talk Tell: He watches your hands, not your face. He wants plain words.>
<Talk Tell 5: Gifts make his bristles rise.>
<Talk Likes: 55>

name: Owl of Ill Omen
note:
Set loose on those who harm the forest. Drinks blood. Yields to Tou at once (First Sailor towers, First Sailor queen).
<Flying>
<Talk Type: spirit>
<Talk Tags: forest>
<Talk Mood: 15>
<Talk Instant: 9>
<Talk Line Calm: Its amber eyes dim. It hoots once, low.>
<Talk Line Pacified: It lifts away toward the ruined towers.>
<Talk Soothe+: Its amber eyes narrow, then soften.>
<Talk Soothe-: It clacks its saber beak.>
<Talk Offer: -5>
<Talk Offer-: It wants blood, not bread.>
<Talk Rite+: It bobs its head slowly with the rite.>
<Talk Threaten-: It spreads its wings and shrieks!>
<Talk Plead+: It turns its head all the way around, considering.>
<Talk Question>
A voice like dry leaves, inside your head: Who gave you leave to be here?
- No one. We're sorry. | +15 | Then go softly.
- The Lady of the Woods. | -20 | A lie. She told us nothing.
- [3] The priests have always walked here. | +15 | Priests... yes. Go softly.
</Talk Question>
<Talk Tell: It keeps glancing toward the old tower. It answers to something older.>

name: All-Seafarer Marine
note:
Act 4 invader (bronze armor, spear and shield). Won't harm children unless Enraged; with only children left, demands surrender.
<Spares Children>
<Metal>
<Talk Type: sapient>
<Talk Tags: soldier>

<Talk Outcome: info>
<Talk Line Calm: "Easy. Nobody needs to die today.">

<Talk Soothe-: "Stay back!">
<Talk Offer+: He pockets it. "...I didn't see you.">
<Talk Ask-: "Orders are orders.">
<Talk Threaten-: "Is that a threat? From a kid?">
<Talk Plead+: He hesitates. "Go home, kid.">
<Talk Offer Results: 75 normal | 25 leave "He pockets it, looks the other way, and marches off.">

What are children doing out here?

- Go home, invader! | -15 | Watch your tongue!
- [8] Easy, friend. I'm from the city too. | +25 | You? What are YOU doing here?
</Talk Question>
<Talk Question>
Is it true your priests talk to ghosts?
- Yes. | +5 | Gods help us.
- Only to the dead ones. | +10 | He laughs, a little too loud.
</Talk Question>
<Talk Tell: He hasn't raised his spear at a child yet. He doesn't want to.>
<Talk Tell 5: His purse is light. A bribe might work.>
<Talk Likes: 2>

Act 2, the tombs. A dead priest still chanting. Raises fallen skeletons: take it down first.

<Talk Rite: 30>
<Talk Line Calm: Its chant falters.>

Who sings over us now?

</Talk Question>

<Talk Ask+: It tugs at something shiny under a rock.>
<Talk Offer Results: 70 normal | 30 gift item 126 "%1 pushes a shell toward you in return.">

<Talk Likes: 52>

name: Daughter of the Wells
note:
Act 2 boss: one of the Lady of the Woods' three daughters, trapped in a First Sailor well and made a snake woman. A rescue: beaten or calmed, she becomes a river maiden again (story event after the battle).
Drag Below: hit her to pull them free.
<Talk Type: spirit>
<Talk Tags: forest, water, first-sailor>
<Talk Mood: 5>
<Talk Rite: 12>
<Talk Plead: 20>
<Talk Line Hostile: "Come down... come down where it's cool..."> 
<Talk Line Calm: The coils slacken. "Who... who is that, up in the light?">
<Talk Line Pacified: The scales fall away. A young woman stands in the well water, weeping. "Mother?">
<Talk Soothe-: She hisses and sinks lower.>
<Talk Rite+: She sways to the old words, half remembering.>
<Talk Plead+: "Little one... why are you crying?">
<Talk Threaten-: "You sound like the ones who chained me!">
<Talk Question>
"Has my mother forgotten me?"
- No. She sent us. | +30 | "...She did?"
- [10] I'm her child too. She never forgot. | +40 | "Brother... little brother..."
- I don't know. | +5 | "Nobody knows. Nobody comes."
- Who's your mother? | -15 | "You don't even KNOW?"
</Talk Question>
<Talk Tell: Under the hissing she's crying for her mother.>
<Talk Tell 5: The First Sailor binding is carved round the well's rim.>

name: Great Boar
note:
Act 2 climax: the largest boar in the Lady's forest. Hunt it only with her leave. Its flesh becomes Yoon's body (story event after the battle). The showcase for animal Talk: Stalk it, then strike.
<Talk Type: animal>
<Talk Tags: forest, boar>
<Talk Mood: 5>
<Talk Soothe: 4>
<Talk Offer: 5>
<Talk Plead: 0>
<Talk Line Calm: It stands still, breathing hard, and looks at you.>
<Talk Soothe+: %1's great sides heave more slowly.>
<Talk Soothe-: %1 tears up the ground.>
<Talk Offer+: %1 eats it, watching you the whole time.>
<Talk Threaten-: %1 squeals, a sound like a tree splitting!>
<Talk Plead0: %1 doesn't care what you want.>
<Talk Tell: Old, scarred, and tired. It knows why you've come.>
<Talk Tell 5: Stalk it: it's watching the trees, not you.>
<Talk Likes: 640>

name: Shepherd of the Deer
note:
Act 2 boss (the snow, in the alpine forest): the Lady's husband, guardian of the wild herds. Calls his herd in two waves (troop events): an eagle and a ram at 70% Health, two more at 35%. Priests teach him songs for stealth magic: a rite works far better than a threat.
<Talk Type: spirit>
<Talk Tags: alpine, forest>
<Talk Mood: 10>
<Talk Rite: 15>
<Talk Threaten: -20>
<Talk Offer: -5>
<Talk Info: "Walk soft in my meadows. Take only snow. Leave the herd its trails.">
<Talk Outcome: info, buff agi 3>
<Talk Line Calm: The red eyes dim. He leans on his crook.>
<Talk Line Pacified: "A new song. Hm. You may take your snow.">
<Talk Rite+: His bristles part. He's listening.>
<Talk Rite-: "I know that song. Sing me one I don't.">
<Talk Threaten-: "A hunter's threat. I know your kind."> 
<Talk Plead+: "The young ones always plead. Why are you up here?">
<Talk Question>
"Why does a child climb to my snow?"
- To bring a friend back to life. | +25 | "...Life is not snow. It doesn't keep."
- [3] To learn your songs, and teach you one. | +35 | "Ahh. A priest."
- [5] I hunt by the agreement. | -10 | "Your arrows are the reason my herd runs."
- It's none of your business. | -20 | "Everything on this mountain is my business."
</Talk Question>
<Talk Tell: He wants a song, not a fight.>

name: Lady of the Woods
note:
Boss (lowland aspect): the rainforest body, a woman with a porcine aspect. Temperamental but gregarious: feed her, talk plainly, and she'd rather feast than fight. Her glyph Geha heals her. Shifts into the Sacred Rain Pig at half Health (troop event); her mood carries over.
<Talk Type: spirit>
<Talk Tags: forest, boar>
<Talk Mood: 5>
<Talk Offer: 10>
<Talk Soothe: 4>
<Talk Rite: 5>
<Talk Plead: 15>
<Talk Threaten: -30>
<Talk Info: "The forest's terms: fallen wood only, fire only in the clearings, the marked trees and no others. Keep them, and you're welcome at my table.">
<Talk Outcome: info>
<Talk Line Hostile: "Thieves! Burners! In MY forest?">
<Talk Line Calm: She snorts, half a laugh. "Well. Sit, then."> 
<Talk Line Pacified: "Eat with me. Then ask what you came to ask.">
<Talk Offer+: She eats it with relish. "Not bad. More?" | She crunches it happily.>
<Talk Offer-: "THAT? You bring THAT to a lady?">
<Talk Soothe0: "Pretty words. My husband makes prettier ones.">
<Talk Threaten-: The whole forest seems to bristle.>
<Talk Offer Results: 75 normal | 25 demand item 640 "She licks her fingers. "Have you got any more of those?"">
<Talk Question>
"What do you want from my woods, little ones?"
- The Great Boar. We need it. | +10 | "...Do you know what you're asking?"
- [10] Mother. It's me. | +40 | "\N[10]! Look at you!"
- Only what you'll give us. | +25 | "Ha! Polite. I like polite."
- Nothing. We're just passing. | -15 | "Nobody just PASSES through my forest."
</Talk Question>
<Talk Tell: She's hungry. She's always hungry.>
<Talk Tell 5: Her temper flares fast and fades fast.>
<Talk Likes: 640, 55>

note:

<Talk Type: sapient>
<Talk Tags: sailor, seafarer>
<Talk Mood: 25>
<Talk Offer: 15>
<Talk Info: "The pearls are for the tribute ship. I wanted one for myself. Is that so terrible, after twenty years of rowing?">
<Talk Outcome: info>
<Talk Line Hostile: "Back off, kids. I don't want to hurt you.">
<Talk Line Calm: He lowers the knife a little. "...What do you want?">
<Talk Line Pacified: "All right. All right. You win.">
<Talk Soothe+: "Easy... easy."> 
<Talk Offer+: He weighs it in his hand. "...Go on."> 
<Talk Threaten-: "From a CHILD? Get out of here."> 
<Talk Plead+: He winces. "Don't do that. Don't cry."> 
<Talk Question>
"Who sent you? Iras? The spearwives?"
- Nobody. We need one pearl. | +25 | "...One pearl. For what?"
- \N[7]'s coming for you. | -10 | "Then I'd better be quick."
- We could help each other. | +20 | "Now THAT's an islander I can talk to."
</Talk Question>
<Talk Tell: He keeps one hand on his pouch. The pearls are in it.>
<Talk Tell 5: He doesn't want to hurt children. He just wants out.>

name: Giant Lizard
note:
Act 3, highlands and volcanic desert. Over a metre long; heals in the sun.
<Talk Type: animal>
<Talk Tags: desert>
<Talk Mood: 30>
<Talk Line Calm: It flattens itself on a warm rock.>
<Talk Soothe+: %1 blinks slowly.>
<Talk Offer+: %1 swallows it whole.>
<Talk Threaten Results: 60 normal | 40 flee "%1 scuttles under the rocks.">
<Talk Tell: Cold-blooded. Slow until the sun warms it.>
<Talk Likes: 44, 50>

name: Giant Tortoise
note:
Act 3, highlands. Ancient and nearly unhurtable: crush it, don't cut it. Seafarers won't wear its shell.
<Talk Type: animal>
<Talk Tags: desert, shelled>
<Talk Mood: 35>
<Talk Soothe: 8>
<Talk Line Calm: It pulls in its head and ignores you.>
<Talk Offer+: %1 chews it for a very long time.>
<Talk Tell: Old as the trail. In no hurry at all.>
<Talk Likes: 50, 640>

name: Vulture
note:
Act 3, highlands and desert. Joins fights late (troop event) and picks on whoever is weakest.
<Flying>
<Targets Weakest>
<Talk Type: animal>
<Talk Tags: desert, bird>
<Talk Mood: 20>
<Talk Line Calm: It hops back and waits. Patient.>
<Talk Offer+: %1 bolts the meat.>
<Talk Offer Results: 60 normal | 40 leave "%1 flaps off with the meat.">
<Talk Tell: It's waiting for someone to fall.>
<Talk Likes: 44>

name: Guardian Lizard
note:
Act 3, pools and springs (also the crater lake). A spirit lizard guarding a water. Tou may know its oath.
<Talk Type: spirit>
<Talk Tags: water, first-sailor>
<Talk Mood: 20>
<Talk Rite: 20>
<Talk Instant: 9>
<Talk Line Calm: It lowers its crest.>
<Talk Line Pacified: It slides back into the pool. The water clears.>
<Talk Rite+: It dips its head to the rite.>
<Talk Offer-: It isn't hungry. It is guarding.>
<Talk Tell: It watches the water, not you. Don't go near the pool.>

name: Leech
note: Act 2-3, the salt marsh. Drinks blood. Salt and fire make it let go.

name: Marsh Eel
note:
Act 2-3, the salt marsh (Aguerekeu). Leaves you soaked.
<Talk Type: animal>
<Talk Tags: marsh>
<Talk Mood: 25>
<Talk Line Calm: It slides back into the reeds.>
<Talk Threaten Results: 50 normal | 50 flee "%1 slips away under the water.">
<Talk Tell: It wants the reeds, not you.>
<Talk Likes: 408>

name: Crane
note:
Act 2-3, the salt marsh. Just a crane. (Probably.)
<Flying>
<Talk Type: animal>
<Talk Tags: marsh, bird>
<Talk Mood: 30>
<Talk Line Calm: It goes back to fishing.>
<Talk Offer+: %1 gulps the fish.>
<Talk Threaten Results: 30 normal | 70 flee "%1 lifts off with a croak.">
<Talk Tell: Just a bird. It wants the fish.>
<Talk Likes: 408>

name: Crane
note:
Act 2-3, the salt marsh. A Marsh Hag in a crane's shape: looks like the ordinary Crane, then turns (troop event: Enemy Transform into the Marsh Hag on turn 2). Talking reveals something is off.
<Flying>
<Talk Type: spirit>
<Talk Tags: marsh, bird>
<Talk Mood: 20>
<Talk Line Calm: It tilts its head... too far.>
<Talk Offer-: It doesn't look at the fish. It looks at you.>
<Talk Tell: Its eyes are wrong. Cranes don't blink like that.>

name: Marsh Hag
note:
Act 2-3, the salt marsh. Vampiric witch of the Lady of the Wind's marsh, a First Sailor remnant. Any crane may be one. Hags dote on Yoon.
<Talk Type: spirit>
<Talk Tags: marsh, wind, first-sailor>
<Talk Mood: 20>
<Talk Plead: 25>
<Talk Line Calm: She cackles, softer. "Ohh, look at this one.">
<Talk Line Pacified: "Off you go, my ducklings. Mind the deep water.">
<Talk Plead+: "Aww. Don't cry, duckling."> 
<Talk Threaten-: "Threaten ME? In MY marsh?">
<Talk Offer+: She sniffs it. "Hm. Sweet thing."> 
<Talk Question>
"Such a pretty little face. Whose child are you?"
- [2] Nobody's. Not any more. | +40 | "Ohh. Poor duckling. Come here, come here."
- [9] Mind your manners, crone. | +10 | "...Your Majesty. Forgive an old woman."
- Stay back! | -15 | "Rude, rude!"
</Talk Question>
<Talk Tell: She keeps looking at \N[2]. Fondly. Hungrily.>
<Talk Likes: 55, 17>

name: Stoneman
note:
Act 3, the volcanic desert. Unfinished moai of soft tuff, walking. First Sailor remnants: they surrender to Tou.
<Talk Type: sapient>
<Talk Tags: stone, first-sailor>
<Talk Mood: 20>
<Talk Instant: 9>
<Talk Line Calm: It stops. Grit trickles from its joints.>
<Talk Line Pacified: It kneels, slowly, like a landslide.>
<Talk Soothe0: It doesn't understand you.>
<Talk Rite+: The old words make it pause.>
<Talk Tell: It waits for orders that never come.>

name: Stoneman Priest
note:
Act 3, the volcanic desert. A Stoneman with salt glyphs cut into it.
<Talk Type: sapient>
<Talk Tags: stone, first-sailor, priest>
<Talk Mood: 20>
<Talk Instant: 9>
<Talk Rite: 20>
<Talk Line Calm: Its glyphs dim.>
<Talk Line Pacified: It kneels and lays its hands on the sand.>
<Talk Rite+: It answers in the old tongue.>
<Talk Tell: Its glyphs are a First Sailor rite. Water washes Salting off.>

name: Stoneman Shaman
note:
Act 3 boss: the oldest Stoneman, keeper of the salt glyphs. Comes with a Stoneman.
<Talk Type: sapient>
<Talk Tags: stone, first-sailor, priest>
<Talk Mood: 5>
<Talk Instant: 9>
<Talk Rite: 8>
<Talk Info: "The Navigator Lords left. We were not finished. We wait.">
<Talk Outcome: info>
<Talk Line Calm: Sand stops pouring from its mouth.>
<Talk Line Pacified: "...Crew. You may pass."> 
<Talk Rite+: "That rite is older than you."> 
<Talk Tell: It is waiting for a Navigator's order. \N[9] could give one.>

name: Guardian of the Crater Lake
note:
Act 3 boss: the greatest Guardian Lizard, guarding the crater lake on the way to the ritual site.
<Talk Type: spirit>
<Talk Tags: water, first-sailor>
<Talk Mood: 5>
<Talk Rite: 8>
<Talk Soothe: 3>
<Talk Instant: 9>
<Talk Line Calm: Its crest lowers. Steam drifts off the lake.>
<Talk Line Pacified: It sinks into the lake without a ripple.>
<Talk Rite+: The old oath echoes off the crater walls.>
<Talk Tell: It guards the lake for someone long gone.>

name: Black Hound
note: Act 3, the volcano and the tubes. The Destroyer's servants. Can't be talked to. Drag Below: hit the hound to pull them free.

name: Black Hound Alpha
note: Act 3, leads a pack. Can't be talked to.

name: Hunched
note:
Act 3, the tubes and graveyards. A corpse ridden by a demon. Talk to free it: the rider lets go and the dead can be laid to rest.
<Talk Type: spirit>
<Talk Tags: dead, demon>
<Talk Mood: 10>
<Talk Rite: 30>
<Talk Offer: -10>
<Talk Line Calm: It shudders. Something inside is losing its grip.>
<Talk Line Pacified: The corpse slumps. Whatever rode it is gone; it can be laid to rest.>
<Talk Rite+: The body jerks against the rider.>
<Talk Plead+: For a moment the dead face looks almost human.>
<Talk Tell: Someone is still in there, under the rider.>

name: Hunched Defiler
note:
Act 3, deeper in. A stronger demon in an older corpse: it uses magic.
<Talk Type: spirit>
<Talk Tags: dead, demon>
<Talk Mood: 5>
<Talk Rite: 25>
<Talk Line Calm: The fire in its mouth gutters.>
<Talk Line Pacified: The rider tears loose with a scream. The body falls still.>
<Talk Tell: The rider is strong. Its grip on this body is old.>

name: The Bull of the Caves
note: Act 3 optional boss: the fire-breathing twin of the Bull of Heaven, guarding treasure in the Destroyer's tubes. Serves the Destroyer; won't listen. Two Black Hounds come at half Health (troop event).

name: Juda
note: Act 3 final boss, on the mountain after he burns Pada. He believes Yoon is the demon he summoned. Won't listen. Optionally beatable: at 0 Health he doesn't die but rises in his partial Navigator Lord form (enemy 50; troop event), which can't fairly be beaten. (Dama's arrival is a story event.)

name: Juda
note:
Act 3: Juda's partial Navigator Lord form, after the party beats him (troop event). Not meant to be beaten: its attacks stop at 1 Health, and after 3 turns the battle ends (switch 9 ON) so the story can carry on.
<Nonlethal>

name: The Sacred Rain Pig
note:
The Lady of the Woods' true lowland form (after she drops to half Health): the sacred pig that brings the rain. Wordless and holy: only a rain rite or food reaches it. Its rain soaks the party (Wet).
<Talk Type: spirit>
<Talk Tags: forest, boar>
<Talk Rite: 25>
<Talk Offer: 10>
<Talk Soothe: 0>
<Talk Plead: 0>
<Talk Threaten: -40>
<Talk Ask: -10>
<Talk Info: The rain falls on all of you, warm, and the forest sighs. The Lady's leave is given.>
<Talk Outcome: info>
<Talk Line Hostile: The great pig paws the mud. Thunder rolls under the canopy.>
<Talk Line Calm: The rain softens to a drizzle. The pig lowers its head.>
<Talk Line Pacified: The rain stops. Steam rises from the leaves, and the pig lies down in the wallow like a hill.>
<Talk Rite+: The rain falls in time with the prayer. | The pig grunts, deep as thunder, along with the words.>
<Talk Rite-: The rain hammers down. Wrong words.>
<Talk Offer+: It takes the offering gently, like a sow from a child's hand.>
<Talk Offer-: It doesn't look at it.>
<Talk Soothe0: Words mean nothing to the rain.>
<Talk Ask-: It does not answer questions.>
<Talk Threaten-: Lightning splits a laurel behind you.>
<Talk Tell: It isn't angry now. It's weather. It wants a rain prayer.>
<Talk Likes: 640>

name: Lady of the Woods
note:
Boss (alpine aspect): the Lady's body in the high pines, polite but cold. Courtesy works (Ask, Rite); gifts insult her; tears don't move her; threats are unforgivable. Her glyph Huhuti entangles. Shifts into the Stern Centaur at half Health (troop event).
<Talk Type: spirit>
<Talk Tags: forest, alpine>
<Talk Mood: 10>
<Talk Ask: 15>
<Talk Rite: 12>
<Talk Soothe: 6>
<Talk Offer: -15>
<Talk Plead: 0>
<Talk Threaten: -40>
<Talk Info: "The high forest's terms are older and stricter: no fire above the treeline, no felling of the old pines, one beast of the herd per family per winter. Keep them exactly.">
<Talk Outcome: info>
<Talk Line Hostile: "You will explain yourselves. Briefly.">
<Talk Line Calm: "Very well. You may continue.">
<Talk Line Pacified: "You have conducted yourselves properly. That is rarer than you would think.">
<Talk Ask+: "A fair question. I will answer it." | She inclines her head, a fraction.>
<Talk Rite+: "Correctly done." | She stands very still for the old words.>
<Talk Soothe+: "Your manners are adequate.">
<Talk Offer-: "Do you think me a market woman, to be bought with food?" | She does not touch it.>
<Talk Plead0: "Tears are not an argument.">
<Talk Threaten-: The air goes very cold.>
<Talk Question>
"By what right do you walk in my high forest?"
- By the agreements. We keep them. | +20 | "Then recite them." She waits.
- [5] I hunt here by the old quota, one beast a winter. | +30 | "Pada. You count correctly."
- [10] Mother. I came to see you. | +35 | "...Falmi. Stand up straight."
- We don't need your permission. | -40 | "Then you will need my patience. You have none left."
</Talk Question>
<Talk Tell: She listens to how you speak, not what you offer.>
<Talk Tell 5: Food would insult her. Questions, asked properly, would not.>

name: The Stern Centaur
note:
The Lady of the Woods' true alpine form (after she drops to half Health): the stern goat-centaur, a judge with a spear. Only formal questions and rites reach her now.
<Talk Type: spirit>
<Talk Tags: forest, alpine>
<Talk Ask: 18>
<Talk Rite: 15>
<Talk Soothe: 0>
<Talk Offer: -25>
<Talk Plead: -5>
<Talk Threaten: -50>
<Talk Info: "Judgement, then: you may pass, and take what the agreements allow. Nothing more.">
<Talk Outcome: info>
<Talk Line Hostile: "Then let us be precise." She levels her spear.>
<Talk Line Calm: The spear point lowers to the snow.>
<Talk Line Pacified: "Judgement is given. Go."> 
<Talk Ask+: "Asked properly. Answered properly." | "That is the right question.">
<Talk Rite+: Her hooves stop on the frozen ground.>
<Talk Offer-: "A bribe. In front of a judge."> 
<Talk Plead-: "Do not beg. Argue.">
<Talk Threaten-: "Unwise.">
<Talk Tell: A judge, not a mother now. Formal questions, nothing else.>

name: Shearwater
note:
Acts 1-2, the haunted coast at night. Burrow-nesting seabirds whose calls sound like crying babies. Night encounters (map note <Night Troops>).
<Flying>
<Talk Type: animal>
<Talk Tags: sea, bird>
<Talk Mood: 25>
<Talk Line Calm: The wailing dies down to a soft cooing.>
<Talk Soothe+: %1 stops crying and shuffles back to its burrow.>
<Talk Soothe-: %1 wails louder.>
<Talk Offer+: %1 gulps the fish.>
<Talk Threaten Results: 40 normal | 60 flee "%1 flaps off into the dark, still crying.">
<Talk Tell: They're only birds. They only SOUND like babies.>
<Talk Tell 5: The old stories say the Master of Deception wept like a child to lure people into the sea. Maybe the birds learned it from him.>
<Talk Likes: 408>

name: Gannet
note:
Acts 1-2, the sea cliffs and shore. A big diving seabird: dive-bombs from above.
<Flying>
<Talk Type: animal>
<Talk Tags: sea, bird>
<Talk Mood: 20>
<Talk Line Calm: It lands on a rock and preens.>
<Talk Offer+: %1 swallows the fish headfirst.>
<Talk Offer Results: 60 normal | 40 leave "%1 grabs the fish and flies off.">
<Talk Threaten-: %1 shrieks and climbs for another dive.>
<Talk Tell: It's fishing. You're in the way.>
<Talk Likes: 408>

name: Shore Crab
note:
Acts 1-2, the black-sand shore and tide pools. Red rock crabs: hard shell, soft underneath. Crush cracks them.
<Talk Type: animal>
<Talk Tags: sea, shelled>
<Talk Mood: 25>
<Talk Line Calm: It sidles back under a rock.>
<Talk Threaten Results: 50 normal | 50 flee "%1 scuttles away sideways.">
<Talk Tell: Its shell is hard, but a heavy blow will crack it.>

name: Spider Crab
note:
Acts 1-2, the shore. A huge, long-legged crab that leads the shore crabs: calls more of them in (troop event).
<Talk Type: animal>
<Talk Tags: sea, shelled>
<Talk Mood: 15>
<Talk Line Calm: It folds its long legs and settles.>
<Talk Threaten-: %1 rears up, claws wide.>
<Talk Offer+: %1 picks at it delicately.>
<Talk Tell: The little crabs follow it. Beat it and they scatter.>
<Talk Likes: 408, 52>

name: Jellyfish
note:
Acts 1-2, drifting in shallow water off the shore. Stings whoever hits it with a weapon.
<Stings: Venom 30>

name: Killer Fish
note:
Act 4+, underwater (Dama's breathing spell). Toothy fish that hunt in shoals.
<Talk Type: animal>
<Talk Tags: sea>
<Talk Mood: 10>
<Talk Line Calm: The shoal turns away as one.>
<Talk Offer+: The shoal tears the fish apart in a moment.>
<Talk Offer Results: 50 normal | 50 leave "%1 chases the fish off into the blue.">
<Talk Tell: Always hungry. Bleeding makes them worse.>
<Talk Likes: 408>

name: Swordfish
note:
Act 4+, the open sea (underwater). Fast, and it runs you through.
<Talk Type: animal>
<Talk Tags: sea>
<Talk Mood: 15>
<Talk Line Calm: It circles once and swims off.>
<Talk Threaten Results: 50 normal | 50 flee "%1 is gone in a flash of silver.">
<Talk Tell: It only attacks what it can't outswim.>

name: Shark
note:
Act 4+, offshore while diving. The sea's great threat: makes you Bleed, and frenzies when hurt.
<Talk Type: animal>
<Talk Tags: sea>
<Talk Mood: 5>
<Talk Line Calm: It turns slowly, unimpressed, and glides away.>
<Talk Soothe0: It doesn't care.>
<Talk Threaten Results: 60 normal | 40 flee "%1 decides you're not worth it.">
<Talk Tell: The Star Mother's creature. Dama would know how to treat it.>
<Talk Tell 5: Sharks respect a hit on the nose more than words.>

name: Laurel Pigeon
note:
Act 2, the laurel forest. Harmless and flighty: the gentle fight that teaches Talk. Soothe it, or offer it seeds.
<Flying>
<Talk Type: animal>
<Talk Tags: forest, bird>
<Talk Mood: 45>
<Talk Soothe: 20>
<Talk Offer: 25>
<Talk Line Calm: It puffs up its chest and coos.>
<Talk Line Pacified: It pecks at the ground beside you, then waddles off, content.>
<Talk Soothe+: %1 coos softly. | %1 tilts its head at you.>
<Talk Offer+: %1 gobbles the seeds.>
<Talk Threaten-: %1 panics and flaps around.>
<Talk Tell: It's more scared of you than you are of it. Try soothing it, or offering seeds.>
<Talk Likes: 406, 638, 623>

name: Wild Bees
note:
Act 2, the Bee Rock gathering spots. A swarm defending its honey. Smoke drives them off: with a Torch lit (Torchlight), they flee (troop event).
Can't be talked to.

name: Barn Owl
note:
Act 2, the forest and fields at night. An ordinary owl: the mundane cousin of the Owls of Ill Omen.
<Flying>
<Talk Type: animal>
<Talk Tags: forest, bird>
<Talk Mood: 25>
<Talk Line Calm: It swivels its head and stares at something else.>
<Talk Soothe+: %1 blinks, very slowly.>
<Talk Offer+: %1 swallows it whole.>
<Talk Tell: Just an owl. A real one. Its eyes are only eyes.>
<Talk Likes: 44>

name: Marsh Frog
note:
Act 2, the salt marsh. A frog the size of a dog: croaks, leaps, and leaves you soaked.
<Talk Type: animal>
<Talk Tags: marsh>
<Talk Mood: 30>
<Talk Line Calm: It settles into the mud and blinks.>
<Talk Offer+: Its tongue snaps the food out of your hand.>
<Talk Threaten Results: 50 normal | 50 flee "%1 plops into the water.">
<Talk Tell: All it wants is to sit in the mud.>
<Talk Likes: 409>

name: Water Snake
note:
Act 2, the salt marsh and streams. Venomous, but it would rather slither away: a threat sends it off.
<Talk Type: animal>
<Talk Tags: marsh>
<Talk Mood: 25>
<Talk Flees: threaten>
<Talk Line Flee: %1 slithers away into the reeds.>
<Talk Line Calm: It coils up and flicks its tongue.>
<Talk Tell: It's scared. Make yourself big and it will go.>

name: Heron
note:
Act 2, the salt marsh. The Crane's twin, and genuinely a heron. Honestly.
<Flying>
<Talk Type: animal>
<Talk Tags: marsh, bird>
<Talk Mood: 30>
<Talk Line Calm: It goes back to standing on one leg.>
<Talk Offer+: %1 gulps the fish.>
<Talk Threaten Results: 30 normal | 70 flee "%1 lifts off with a croak.">
<Talk Tell: Just a heron. Really. Its eyes blink the right way.>
<Talk Likes: 408>

name: Aurochs Calf
note:
Act 3, the highlands. A young aurochs. Harmless, but hurt it and the herd bull charges in (troop event).
<Talk Type: animal>
<Talk Tags: alpine>
<Talk Mood: 40>
<Talk Line Calm: It licks your hand.>
<Talk Line Pacified: It trots off after the herd.>
<Talk Offer+: %1 munches it happily.>
<Talk Tell: Its herd is close. Very close.>
<Talk Likes: 198, 640>

name: Aurochs
note:
Act 3, the highlands (rare). Huge wild cattle, the ancestors of the Seafarers' cows: a charging, trampling beast to hunt.
<Talk Type: animal>
<Talk Tags: alpine>
<Talk Mood: 15>
<Talk Line Calm: It snorts, lowers its head to graze, and keeps one eye on you.>
<Talk Soothe-: %1 paws the ground.>
<Talk Offer+: %1 licks the salt with a tongue like a rasp.>
<Talk Threaten-: %1 lowers its horns!>
<Talk Tell: It's guarding the herd. Back away slowly and it may let you.>
<Talk Likes: 198, 156>

name: Ridden Aurochs
note:
Act 4+, with the Destroyer's forces. A dead aurochs ridden by a demon, used as a battering ram. Talk like the Hunched: a rite frees the carcass.
<Talk Type: spirit>
<Talk Tags: dead, demon>
<Talk Mood: 5>
<Talk Rite: 25>
<Talk Offer: -10>
<Talk Line Calm: The dead bull staggers. The rider's grip is slipping.>
<Talk Line Pacified: The rider lets go. The great body crashes down and lies still.>
<Talk Rite+: The carcass bellows, but not at you.>
<Talk Tell: The rider is using it like a ram at a gate.>

name: Rock Lizard
note:
Act 3, the highlands and desert edge. The Giant Lizard's smaller cousins.
<Talk Type: animal>
<Talk Tags: desert>
<Talk Mood: 30>
<Talk Line Calm: It does push-ups on its rock, then ignores you.>
<Talk Threaten Results: 50 normal | 50 flee "%1 darts into a crack.">
<Talk Tell: Fast when it's warm, slow when it's not.>
<Talk Likes: 44>

name: Desert Scorpion
note:
Act 3, the volcanic desert. Venomous pests under every stone.
<Talk Type: animal>
<Talk Tags: desert>
<Talk Mood: 10>
<Talk Soothe0: It doesn't understand kindness.>
<Talk Threaten Results: 60 normal | 40 flee "%1 backs under a stone.">
<Talk Tell: Watch the tail, not the claws.>

name: Hawk
note:
Act 3, the dry slopes. A smaller raptor than the Golden Eagle, and faster.
<Flying>
<Talk Type: animal>
<Talk Tags: desert, bird>
<Talk Mood: 20>
<Talk Line Calm: It rides the heat up and away.>
<Talk Offer+: %1 snatches the meat.>
<Talk Offer Results: 60 normal | 40 leave "%1 takes it and wheels away.">
<Talk Tell: It wants food, not a fight.>
<Talk Likes: 44>

name: Cave Spider
note:
Acts 1-3, the lava tubes. Pale and leggy: webs that leave you Entangled.
<Talk Type: animal>
<Talk Tags: cave>
<Talk Mood: 20>
<Talk Line Calm: It climbs back up its thread.>
<Talk Threaten Results: 50 normal | 50 flee "%1 scuttles into a crack.">
<Talk Tell: Light bothers it. Its web is behind it.>

name: Snow-line Hare
note:
Act 2, the alpine meadows up to the snow line. Fast and skittish: it may bolt.
<Talk Type: animal>
<Talk Tags: alpine>
<Talk Mood: 30>
<Talk Flees: threaten>
<Talk Line Flee: %1 bounds away over the snow.>
<Talk Line Calm: It sits up, ears high.>
<Talk Offer+: %1 nibbles it, nose twitching.>
<Talk Tell: One loud noise and it's gone.>
<Talk Likes: 640, 641>
